# Exit codes of `centcom -p`

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | done |
| 1 | error |
| 2 | bad usage |
| 3 | finished, but an action needed an approval that nobody could give |
| 4 | the agent is not installed or not signed in |
| 5 | plan or rate limit |
| 6 | the agent or the service was not reachable |
| 124 | timeout |
| 130 | interrupted |
